newsitem.title: USA: Communications Systems Q2 strong so far.
newsitem.headline: Communications Systems Q2 strong so far.

text.p: Communications Systems Inc said Thursday its first quarter results did not meet estimates but the current second quarter has so far been a strong period.

The company said first quarter operating results were below forecasted levels, primarily because of delayed shipments of its Corro-Shield connectors resulting from a third-party supplier's process problem.
"In the absence of this situation, which was remedied before quarter-end...the company would have reported near-record first quarter sales and earnings," Communications Systems said in a statement.
The company said it is now meeting scheduled shipments of its production backlog.

"The second quarter of 1997 is currently shaping up as a strong period for the company," Communications Systems said. "The company's performance is expected to benefit from growing order levels for Corro-Shield and fiber optic products, as well as from increased volumes of business in Asian and Caribbean markets."
Communications Systems, which provides telecommunications connecting devices and wiring systems, reported first quarter net earnings of $0.24 a share versus $0.22 a share last year.
First quarter earnings were also hurt by a one-time increase in the price of plastic. Increased selling expenses were also posted, the company said.
